title: feat(build): expose /es as a real es module
body:
<!--
  Thanks for submitting a pull request!

**Summary**

- [x] add a package.json with {type: module} to the root of /es
- [x] add (fully resolved) .js extension to all imports via babel
- [x] setup storybook for dealing with the new paths
- [x] setup eslint for dealing with the new paths
- [x] add tests for module exports
- [x] update preact to a later version which supports module exports


<!--
  Explain the **motivation** for making this change.
  What existing problem does the pull request solve?
  Are there any linked issues?
-->

**Result**

FX-534

instantsearch.js is now a real es module, but the paths or package for root isn't changed, as most imports are set manually

For users this shouldn't change anything, as the only difference will be that /es is marked as {type:module} and all of the imports are fully specified. If they're on older stacks that should not have an impact at all, but obviously needs to be researched
